about_short_description.short_description: MinIO delivers unmatched enterprise performance, scale, agility and economics for AI data, agentic computing, and analytics.

product.name: MinIO AIStor
product.description: An enterprise object data store for AI, analytics, and agentic computing, supporting S3-compatible objects, Apache Iceberg tables, and SFTP-accessible files.

product.name: MinIO MemKV
product.description: A context memory store for AI inference that provides shared, petabyte-scale storage for inference context and KV-cache data.

product.name: MinIO Community Edition
product.description: An open-source, S3-compatible object storage server for structured and unstructured data, available for self-managed deployments.

product.name: MinIO DirectPV
product.description: A Kubernetes CSI driver and distributed persistent-volume manager for discovering, provisioning, mounting, scheduling, and monitoring direct-attached drives.

product.name: MinIO Support
product.description: Technical and operational support for MinIO deployments, including product issue resolution, deployment assistance, and direct-to-engineering support.

product.name: MinIO Academy
product.description: A training and certification program offering online courses, hands-on labs, webinars, instructor-led training, and MinIO administrator certification.
